name: language-tools
description: Official VS Code extension for Symfony

scripts.check: tsc -p ./ --noEmit && tsc -p ./tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && npm run check:guide && npm run check:licenses
scripts.package: npm run compile:production && vsce package --readme-path MARKETPLACE.md --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/symfony/language-tools/raw/HEAD/editor/vscode
scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && node out/test/runTest.js

symfonyLsp.serverPath.description: Absolute path overriding the Symfony Language Tools executable bundled with the extension.

symfonyLsp.memoryLimit.description: PHP memory limit for the language server process, such as 512M, 4G or -1 for unlimited. Leave empty to use the server default of 2G.

symfonyLsp.phpCommand.description: Command and arguments used to run the project bridge.

symfonyLsp.containerProjectRoot.description: Absolute project root as seen by the PHP command when it runs in a Docker container. The built-in default runs the PHP command on this machine.

symfonyLsp.environment.description: Symfony environment used for runtime indexing. The built-in default is dev.

symfonyLsp.debug.description: Enable kernel debug mode, which is required for runtime indexing and defaults to true.

symfonyLsp.runtimeIndexing.description: Enable trusted runtime indexing. The built-in default is true.

symfonyLsp.releaseMetadata.description: Allow runtime indexing to request Symfony release metadata for the installed-branch support check. The built-in default is true.

symfonyLsp.bridgeTimeout.description: Maximum number of seconds allowed for each project bridge run.

symfonyLsp.excludePaths.description: Project-relative path patterns excluded from indexing and diagnostics. Explicit check paths remain selectable.

symfonyLsp.projectRoots.description: Explicit application roots, relative to each workspace folder or absolute. The built-in default discovers projects automatically.

symfonyLsp.trace.description: Write redacted Language Server Protocol traffic and verbose runtime failure causes to the Symfony Language Tools output channel.

symfonyLsp.translationDiagnostics.description: Report statically known translation keys missing from the effective catalogue. The built-in default is false.
